issues.detail: The Greek 'νυν' (nyn) means 'now', but the Vietnamese translation uses 'vừa rồi' (just now/recently), which shifts the temporal focus slightly. More importantly, the Greek 'εζητουν' (ezētoun) is an imperfect verb indicating ongoing or repeated action ('were seeking'), whereas the Vietnamese 'tìm' (searched/tried) misses the continuous aspect of the original.
